events.title: New Years Eve Legends
events.desc: Ring in the new year with the Nitro New Year's Eve event! Celebrate the end of the year and start the new year with high-speed racing alongside the Nitro Type community. Sharpen your typing skills, race your way onto the podium, and start the new year as a champion!
